description: Find specific BRANDS within a category that have proven multi-seller demand but are still under-competed (a min-seller floor drops single-seller / brand-owner-only listings). Returns BRANDS — not niches or sub-categories. Use for 'undercompeted brands in <category>', 'low competition brands in Toys', 'which brands can I source in <category>'. Do NOT use for 'under-served niches', 'niches in <category>', or 'find a niche to enter' — those are SUBCATEGORY questions; use find_underserved_niches instead.

category_id.description: Root category ID to search within.

category_name.description: Category name (fuzzy match if category_id not provided).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

max_avg_price.description: Maximum average price in USD. Omit for no cap.

min_avg_price.description: Minimum average price in USD. Omit for no floor.

min_buybox_days.description: Minimum observed buybox days in last 3 months (default 30).

min_sellers.description: Minimum unique sellers (default 10). Drops single-seller / brand-owner-only 'PL junk' so results show proven multi-seller demand.

name: category_undercompeted_brands
